body:
6\. Watchdog can take over from a working lead 🐞 Bug ☼ Reliability 
cmd_watchdog passes takeover=lease_of(values)[0] != "none" to alarm_stage, which calls
watchdog_start as soon as silent_after has passed since the last LEAD-STARTED or LEAD ONLINE.
Nothing checks whether the lease holder is still alive. Progress counts only step and pr changes,
mission-branch pushes and merges, so a live lead whose builders run past three hours with no merge
is enough to trigger it. The takeover lead runs lease take --takeover and the working lead loses
the lease mid-build. Before this PR the watchdog only alarmed, and the architect checked whether the
lead was alive before giving out a takeover line.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The watchdog starts a takeover lead as soon as `silent_after` has passed with no step, pr or branch progress. It does this even when the lease holder is alive and waiting on long-running builders, and the takeover takes the lease from a working lead. ## Fix Focus Areas - room.py[2997-3039] - room.py[3185-3196] ## Recommended Fix Count the lease holder's recent trusted lead messages (for example any lead STATUS or other lead message from the lease holder's session) as a sign of a lead in `stall_episode`'s `sign`, or delay the first takeover start until one alarm interval after the first LEAD-SILENT. That gives a live lead the chance to answer with a STATUS, as LEAD.md asks. Add a test where the holder posts a STATUS after the alarm: the watchdog should not start a takeover. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
